faq_heading: Homes near Pacific Heights Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Pacific Heights Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Pacific Heights Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Pacific Heights Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Pacific Heights Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 28 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,944,475, townhomes $846,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Pacific Heights Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Pacific Heights Elementary the median was 43 days on the market, closing at 96.3% of the list price, with 4% of sales above the list price for the 28 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Pacific Heights Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Grandview Heights Secondary (0.3 km south-west), Edgewood Elementary (1.1 km south-west) and Southridge School (2.2 km west).

Pacific Heights Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 17148 26 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7. Programs listed: Early French Immersion.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Pacific Heights Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the Pacific Heights Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Pacific Heights Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Pacific Heights Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 28 homes sold within 1 km of Pacific Heights Elementary: 12 houses, 11 townhomes and 1 condo. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,944,475.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Pacific Heights Elementary

5 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Pacific Heights Elementary in a straight line (3 elementary, 1 secondary, 1 other; 1 independent). The closest is Grandview Heights Secondary, 0.3 km away, and the farthest on this list is East Kensington Elementary, 2.5 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Edgewood Elementary (1.1 km); the nearest independent school is Southridge School (2.2 km). Other elementary schools close by: Edgewood Elementary (1.1 km south-west), Sunnyside Elementary (2.5 km west), East Kensington Elementary (2.5 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Edgewood Elementary, 1.1 km south-west of Pacific Heights Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Pacific Heights Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Pacific Heights Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Pacific Heights Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Pacific Heights Elementary was $1,944,475, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Edgewood Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 1.1 km south-west of Pacific Heights Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
